Bash(cmd /c "chcp 65001 >nul && python -c ""
import math

print\(''='' * 70\)
print\(''Gusset Plate Strength Check''\)
print\(''KDS 14 31 10/25 Steel Structure Design''\)
print\(''='' * 70\)
print\(\)

# 1. Plate Geometry
print\(''1. Plate Geometry Analysis''\)
print\(''-'' * 50\)

plate_t = 6  # mm
plate_Fy = 235  # MPa \(SS400\)
plate_Fu = 400  # MPa \(SS400\)
hole_d = 14  # mm \(M12 + 2mm\)
n_bolts = 4
W_eff = 100  # mm \(estimated\)

print\(''Plate thickness: t = %d mm'' % plate_t\)
print\(''Effective width: W = %d mm \(estimated\)'' % W_eff\)
print\(''Material: SS400 \(Fy=%d MPa, Fu=%d MPa\)'' % \(plate_Fy, plate_Fu\)\)
print\(''Bolt holes: %d mm dia x %d EA'' % \(hole_d, n_bolts\)\)
print\(\)

# 2. Gross Section Yielding
print\(''2. Gross Section Yielding \(KDS 14 31 10 Sec 4.1.3.1\)''\)
print\(''-'' * 50\)
Ag = W_eff * plate_t
Pn_yield = plate_Fy * Ag / 1000
phi_Pn_yield = 0.90 * Pn_yield
print\(''Ag = %d x %d = %d mm2'' % \(W_eff, plate_t, Ag\)\)
print\(''Pn = %d x %d / 1000 = %.2f kN'' % \(plate_Fy, Ag, Pn_yield\)\)
print\(''phi_Pn = 0.90 x %.2f = %.2f kN'' % \(Pn_yield, phi_Pn_yield\)\)
print\(\)

# 3. Net Section Rupture
print\(''3. Net Section Rupture \(KDS 14 31 10 Sec 4.1.3.2\)''\)
print\(''-'' * 50\)
n_holes = 2
An = \(W_eff - n_holes * hole_d\) * plate_t
U = 1.0
Ae = U * An
Pn_rupture = plate_Fu * Ae / 1000
phi_Pn_rupture = 0.75 * Pn_rupture
print\(''An = \(%d - %d x %d\) x %d = %d mm2'' % \(W_eff, n_holes, hole_d, plate_t, An\)\)
print\(''Ae = %.1f x %d = %d mm2'' % \(U, An, Ae\)\)
print\(''Pn = %d x %d / 1000 = %.2f kN'' % \(plate_Fu, Ae, Pn_rupture\)\)
print\(''phi_Pn = 0.75 x %.2f = %.2f kN'' % \(Pn_rupture, phi_Pn_rupture\)\)
print\(\)

# 4. Block Shear Rupture
print\(''4. Block Shear Rupture \(KDS 14 31 25 Sec 4.1.4.3\)''\)
print\(''-'' * 50\)
bolt_sp = 50  # bolt spacing
edge_d = 20   # edge distance
Lnt = bolt_sp
Ant = \(Lnt - hole_d\) * plate_t
Lgv = edge_d + bolt_sp
Agv = 2 * Lgv * plate_t
Anv = 2 * \(Lgv - 1.5 * hole_d\) * plate_t
Ubs = 1.0
Rn1 = \(0.6 * plate_Fu * Anv + Ubs * plate_Fu * Ant\) / 1000
Rn2 = \(0.6 * plate_Fy * Agv + Ubs * plate_Fu * Ant\) / 1000
Rn_block = min\(Rn1, Rn2\)
phi_Rn_block = 0.75 * Rn_block
print\(''Ant = \(%d - %d\) x %d = %d mm2'' % \(Lnt, hole_d, plate_t, Ant\)\)
print\(''Agv = 2 x %d x %d = %d mm2'' % \(Lgv, plate_t, Agv\)\)
print\(''Anv = 2 x \(%d - 1.5 x %d\) x %d = %d mm2'' % \(Lgv, hole_d, plate_t, Anv\)\)
print\(''Rn1 = %.2f kN, Rn2 = %.2f kN'' % \(Rn1, Rn2\)\)
print\(''Rn = min\(%.2f, %.2f\) = %.2f kN'' % \(Rn1, Rn2, Rn_block\)\)
print\(''phi_Rn = 0.75 x %.2f = %.2f kN'' % \(Rn_block, phi_Rn_block\)\)
print\(\)

# 5. Summary
print\(''5. Summary''\)
print\(''='' * 70\)
print\(''Gross yielding:  phi_Pn = %.2f kN'' % phi_Pn_yield\)
print\(''Net rupture:     phi_Pn = %.2f kN'' % phi_Pn_rupture\)
print\(''Block shear:     phi_Rn = %.2f kN'' % phi_Rn_block\)
print\(\)
min_str = min\(phi_Pn_yield, phi_Pn_rupture, phi_Rn_block\)
bolt_str = 54.29
print\(''Plate strength:  %.2f kN'' % min_str\)
print\(''Bolt strength:   %.2f kN'' % bolt_str\)
print\(\)
if min_str >= bolt_str:
    print\(''=> Plate OK \(%.2f >= %.2f\)'' % \(min_str, bolt_str\)\)
else:
    print\(''=> Plate NG \(%.2f < %.2f\)'' % \(min_str, bolt_str\)\)
print\(''='' * 70\)
""")
